top.title: ADMA 3-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: ADMA Biologics, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Class Action Lawsuit– Hagens Berman
top.summary: ADMA Biologics is facing a securities fraud class action lawsuit alleging misrepresentations regarding financial condition, revenue recognition, and undisclosed related-party transactions. A short-seller report in March 2026 revealed channel stuffing and improper accounting practices, causing the stock to plunge 31.6% over two trading days. The lawsuit covers the period from August 9, 2024 to March 25, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 10, 2026.

top.title: MONDAY INVESTOR DEADLINE: ADMA Biologics, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Class Action Lawsuit, Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP Announces - ADMA
top.summary: ADMA Biologics is facing a securities class action lawsuit alleging the company made false statements regarding undisclosed related party transactions, channel stuffing schemes, and inadequate internal controls. A Culper Research report claimed ADMA's reported 20% growth in 2025 was artificially inflated, with actual revenue declining 3% when adjusted for extended payment terms. The stock declined over 16% following the report, and an additional 13% after a Cantor Fitzgerald downgrade. Investors with substantial losses can seek lead plaintiff status by Monday, August 10, 2026.

top.title: DEADLINE ALERT for FUTU, FSLR, BRCB, ADMA: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith Reminds Investors of Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Class Actions
top.summary: Class action lawsuits have been filed against four publicly-traded companies for alleged securities fraud. Futu Holdings faces allegations of non-compliance with Chinese regulatory requirements, First Solar allegedly overstated its ability to manage tariff impacts, Black Rock Coffee Bar allegedly misrepresented its expansion strategy and cannibalization effects, and ADMA Biologics allegedly engaged in undisclosed related party transactions and channel stuffing. Investors have until mid-to-late August 2026 to file lead plaintiff motions.

top.title: Deadline Alert: ADMA Biologics, Inc. (ADMA) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit

Culper Research reported that ADMA induced distributors to stock excess inventory through rebates and extended payment terms to artificially inflate revenue growth. iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Helium dominates with 38.2% market share, while xenon is the fastest-growing segment at 8.7% CAGR. North America leads with 27.5% market share, followed by strong growth in Asia Pacific.

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -4.2 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -4.2 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Growth is driven by increasing demand for polymer foam blowing agents, aerospace and fuel cell applications, and pharmaceutical intermediates. The 60%-85% concentration range dominates the market, while polymers and blowing agents represent the largest application segment at 42% market share. APAC leads globally with 44% market share, while the US and Europe markets are expected to reach USD 111.54 million and USD 126.94 million respectively by 2035.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.6 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -3.6 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Bloom Energy Corporation on behalf of investors who purchased securities between February 27, 2025 and July 8, 2026. top.title: Shareholders who lost money in shares of Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE: BE) should contact Wolf Haldenstein Immediately
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Bloom Energy Corporation for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its supply chain. The company allegedly obtained scandium through intermediaries sourcing from China while misrepresenting its reliance on Chinese materials. A July 8, 2026 report by Hunterbrook Media exposed multiple China-linked routes in Bloom's supply chain, causing the stock to fall nearly 6%. Investors who purchased shares between February 27, 2025 and July 8, 2026 may be eligible to participate in the lawsuit.

top.title: Kaplan Fox Encourages Bloom Energy Corporation (NYSE: BE) Investors with Significant Losses to Contact the Firm Before September 28, 2026
top.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed a class action lawsuit against Bloom Energy Corporation for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding its reliance on Chinese scandium. The complaint alleges that the company obtained scandium through intermediaries sourcing from China but failed to adequately disclose this dependency to investors. The class period covers purchases between February 27, 2025 and July 8, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of September 28, 2026.

top.title: BE INVESTOR ALERT: Bloom Energy Corporation Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Class Action Lawsuit, Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP Announces
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Bloom Energy Corporation for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its reliance on Chinese-sourced scandium in its fuel cell systems. The lawsuit was triggered by a July 8, 2026 report that revealed Bloom Energy obtained scandium through intermediaries sourcing from China, causing the stock to fall nearly 6%. Investors who purchased BE securities between February 27, 2025 and July 8, 2026 can seek appointment as lead plaintiff by September 28, 2026.

top.title: BRCB 10-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. Facing Securities Class Action Related to IPO Disclosures Regarding Adverse Impact of Sales Transfer Phenomenon – Hagens Berman
top.summary: Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. (NASDAQ: BRCB) is facing a securities class action lawsuit alleging the company made false and misleading statements about its expansion strategy during its September 2025 IPO. The complaint claims management concealed significant 'sales transfer' (cannibalization) issues caused by aggressive store density expansion, which eroded same-store sales growth. The stock has declined over 61% from its IPO price to $7.72 as of June 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 17, 2026.

top.title: BRCB DEADLINE: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important August 17 Deadline in Securities Class Action - BRCB
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. for allegedly making materially false statements in its IPO registration statement and throughout the Class Period (September 12, 2025 - May 12, 2026). The lawsuit claims defendants failed to disclose that new store openings were cannibalizing existing revenue through 'sales transfer,' materially impacting financial results. Investors with losses exceeding $100K are encouraged to join the class action before the August 17, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

top.title: DEADLINE ALERT for FUTU, FSLR, BRCB, ADMA: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith Reminds Investors of Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Class Actions
top.summary: Class action lawsuits have been filed against four publicly-traded companies for alleged securities fraud. Futu Holdings faces allegations of non-compliance with Chinese regulatory requirements, First Solar allegedly overstated its ability to manage tariff impacts, Black Rock Coffee Bar allegedly misrepresented its expansion strategy and cannibalization effects, and ADMA Biologics allegedly engaged in undisclosed related party transactions and channel stuffing. Investors have until mid-to-late August 2026 to file lead plaintiff motions.

top.title: Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. (BRCB) Faces Securities Class Action Related to IPO Disclosures Regarding Adverse Impact of Sales Transfer Phenomenon – Hagens Berman
top.summary: Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. (NASDAQ: BRCB) is facing a securities class action lawsuit alleging the company made false and misleading statements during its September 2025 IPO regarding its expansion strategy. The complaint claims management concealed that new store openings were causing significant cannibalization of existing locations' sales, contradicting assurances of 'limited sales transfer.' The stock has declined over 61% from its IPO price to $7.72 as of the lawsuit filing in June 2026.

Shareholders who purchased shares between January 22, 2025 and May 13, 2026 are encouraged to participate, with an August 7, 2026 deadline.

top.title: Peabody Energy Corporation (BTU) Facing Securities Class Action Related to Surprise Centurion Problems – HBSS
top.summary: Hagens Berman is investigating Peabody Energy Corporation for alleged securities violations related to misleading statements about its Centurion coal mine in Australia. The company allegedly misrepresented the mine's operational status and production capabilities to investors. Peabody slashed Q1 Centurion production guidance from 700,000 tons to 250,000 tons in March 2026 and further reduced full-year sales outlook to 2.5 million tons in May 2026, causing significant stock price declines. The class action covers the period from October 14, 2024 to May 4, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 24, 2026.

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+9.4% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +9.4%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +4.8 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +4.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

reasons.en: call-over-put richness building vs the prior session — demand rotating up
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期上升 — 需求转向上行

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: argenx Announces Commencement of Tender Offer to Acquire Forte Biosciences, Inc.
top.summary: argenx announced a tender offer to acquire Forte Biosciences for $77 per share in cash. The acquisition adds Forte's first-in-class anti-CD122 monoclonal antibody FB102 to argenx's immunology pipeline. The tender offer commenced on August 6, 2026, with an expiration date of August 26, 2026, and is not subject to a financing condition. Forte's Board of Directors has recommended stockholders accept the offer.

top.title: Halper Sadeh LLC is Investigating Whether FBRX, LXFR, SMTI, MKTX are Obtaining Fair Deals for their Shareholders
top.summary: Halper Sadeh LLC, an investor rights law firm, is investigating four companies for potential violations of federal securities laws and breaches of fiduciary duties related to their proposed acquisitions. The firm is examining whether insiders are receiving substantial benefits unavailable to ordinary shareholders and whether transaction terms limit competing offers. The investigations cover Forte Biosciences' sale to argenx, Luxfer Holdings' sale to Wynnchurch Capital affiliates, Sanara MedTech's sale to MiMedx Group, and MarketAxess Holdings' sale to Intercontinental Exchange.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

Investors who purchased FUTU securities between May 24, 2023 and May 27, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 25, 2026.

top.title: Pixalate Releases Q2 2026 Mobile Seller Trust Index 2.0: 15.2% of Global Authorized Mobile App Inventory Is Resold Through Arbitrage, Down From 16.2% in Q1; Google AdExchange Top-Ranked 'Direct' Seller in the US, Germany, Singapore
top.summary: Pixalate released its Q2 2026 Mobile Seller Trust Index 2.0, showing that 15.2% of global authorized mobile app inventory is resold through arbitrage, down from 16.2% in Q1 2026. Google AdExchange ranks as the top 'Direct' seller in the US, Germany, and Singapore. The share of mobile sellers primarily acting as arbitrageurs decreased globally from 31.7% to 29.5%, with notable improvements in the US market dropping from 22% to 16%.

top.title: Pixalate Releases Q2 2026 CTV Seller Trust Index 2.0: Less Than 1% of CTV Inventory In US Resold Through Arbitrage, Lowest of Any Channel; Magnite, Google AdExchange, OpenX Among Top-Ranked 'Direct' Sellers
top.summary: Pixalate released its Q2 2026 Connected TV Seller Trust Index 2.0, ranking 125+ programmatic CTV ad sellers across major platforms. The index found that less than 1% of CTV inventory in the US is resold through arbitrage—the lowest of any channel—with Google AdExchange, Magnite, and OpenX among the top-ranked direct sellers. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +1.5 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +1.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

reasons.en: call-over-put richness building vs the prior session — demand rotating up
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期上升 — 需求转向上行

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Halper Sadeh LLC is Investigating Whether FBRX, LXFR, SMTI, MKTX are Obtaining Fair Deals for their Shareholders
top.summary: Halper Sadeh LLC, an investor rights law firm, is investigating four companies for potential violations of federal securities laws and breaches of fiduciary duties related to their proposed acquisitions. The firm is examining whether insiders are receiving substantial benefits unavailable to ordinary shareholders and whether transaction terms limit competing offers. The investigations cover Forte Biosciences' sale to argenx, Luxfer Holdings' sale to Wynnchurch Capital affiliates, Sanara MedTech's sale to MiMedx Group, and MarketAxess Holdings' sale to Intercontinental Exchange.

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (400) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（400）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up
reasons.zh: 在上沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘突破即向上释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -10.0 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -10.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

notes.en: Forward risk cone is favourable (≈19% median upside vs ≈12% average drawdown) — a constructive risk SHAPE the factor axes don't price.
notes.zh: 前瞻风险锥形态有利（中位上行约 19% 对平均回撤约 12%）——因子维度未计入的有利风险形态。

top.title: Deadline Alert: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. (NNOX) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: A class action securities fraud lawsuit has been filed against Nano-X Imaging Ltd. for allegedly making false statements about operational efficiency and product demand. gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-1.0 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-1.0 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

The company is accused of misleading investors about U.S. handpiece sales that exceeded procedures, resulting in over 10,000 units of excess inventory that would cause significant revenue declines. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 have until September 22, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

top.title: Kaplan Fox Encourages PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation (NASDAQ: PRCT) Investors with Significant Losses to Contact the Firm Before September 22, 2026
top.summary: Kaplan Fox & Kilsheimer LLP has filed class action lawsuits against PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation for allegedly using undisclosed discount programs that artificially inflated handpiece unit sales and revenues during the Class Period (February 28, 2024 - February 25, 2026). The firm is also pursuing cases against Hub Group, Inc. and investigating potential securities violations at Alignment Healthcare, Inc. Investors with losses are encouraged to contact the firm before respective deadlines.

top.title: Important Notice to Long-Term Shareholders of Erasca, Inc. (NASDAQ: ERAS); Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD); Power Solutions International, Inc. (NASDAQ: PSIX); and PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation (NASDAQ: PRCT): Grabar Law Office is Investigating Claims on Your Behalf
top.summary: Grabar Law Office has filed federal securities fraud class action investigations against four companies: Erasca for misleading statements about its ERAS-0015 drug candidate and undisclosed patent risks; Insulet for defective manufacturing controls leading to voluntary product corrections; Power Solutions for overstating sales demand and understating manufacturing costs; and PROCEPT BioRobotics for using undisclosed discount programs that artificially inflated sales and created excess inventory. Shareholders who purchased shares during specified periods are eligible to seek damages and corporate reforms.

top.title: Deadline Alert: PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation (PRCT) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation alleging securities fraud. The company allegedly failed to disclose an extensive discount program that artificially inflated handpiece sales and revenues between February 2024 and February 2026. The undisclosed practices led to excess field inventory exceeding 10,000 units and significant stock price declines following quarterly earnings announcements. Shareholders who purchased PROCEPT securities during the class period have until September 22, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

top.summary: ClaimsFiler reminds investors with losses exceeding $100,000 that they have until September 21, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications in a securities class action lawsuit against Primoris Services Corporation. The company and its executives are accused of failing to disclose material information about substantial challenges, cost overruns, and project delays in its renewable energy segment, resulting in overstated 2026 guidance and misleading statements about business prospects.

top.title: Primoris Services Corporation Notice of September 21, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Reed Kathrein at Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro LLP Before Application Deadline
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Primoris Services Corporation and its executives for allegedly misleading investors about the company's project management capabilities. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased shares between August 5, 2025 and June 22, 2026. Primoris shares experienced two major selloffs in six weeks—a 50% crash on May 6, 2026 and a 21% decline on June 23, 2026—following revelations of significant project management deficiencies in renewable energy projects. The company's market capitalization lost over $6 billion during this period. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 21, 2026.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Primoris Services Corporation (PRIM) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: A class action securities fraud lawsuit has been filed against Primoris Services Corporation for allegedly making false statements about its renewable energy business between August 2025 and June 2026. The company failed to disclose deficient cost estimation processes and material cost overruns on fixed-price projects, leading to significant stock price declines totaling over 50% during the class period. Investors have until September 21, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

top.title: Primoris Services Corporation Notice of September 21, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
top.summary: A class action securities lawsuit has been filed against Primoris Services Corporation for allegedly failing to disclose material information about substantial challenges, cost overruns, and project delays affecting six renewable energy projects. The company reduced its 2026 guidance and announced its COO's resignation on June 22, 2026, resulting in a 22% stock price decline. Investors who purchased shares between August 5, 2025 and June 22, 2026 have until September 21, 2026 to request lead plaintiff status.

The lawsuit claims Roblox concealed that age verification rollout would cause significant growth slowdown, reduced on-platform communication, and declining app store ratings. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 7, 2026.

top.title: RBLX 2-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Roblox Corporation (RBLX) Facing Securities Class Action Amid Surprise Age Verification Impact, Investors with Losses Encouraged to Contact Hagens Berman
top.summary: Hagens Berman has expanded a securities class action lawsuit against Roblox Corporation (RBLX), covering investors who purchased stock between October 31, 2024 and April 30, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Roblox misled investors about its safety commitments and the impact of its age verification rollout, which began in November 2025. The announcement of enhanced age verification caused a 16% stock decline, and subsequent disclosures revealed significant DAU growth deceleration, reduced app store ratings, and slashed revenue guidance, with only 51% of global DAUs completing age verification.

top.title: 72 HOUR DEADLINE ALERT: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Notifies Roblox (RBLX) Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on August 7, 2026
top.summary: A federal securities class action has been filed against Roblox Corporation alleging that executives made false and misleading statements about the company's organic growth potential. The lawsuit claims Roblox concealed that its age verification rollout would significantly slow growth rates and reduce engagement. On April 30, 2026, when Roblox revealed the true impact, its stock plummeted 18.33% in a single day from $55.26 to $45.13 per share. Investors who purchased RBLX securities between October 31, 2024 and April 30, 2026 may be eligible to participate, with a deadline of August 7, 2026 to seek lead plaintiff appointment.

top.title: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Regeneron Class Action Lawsuit – Hagens Berman
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Regeneron Pharmaceuticals after its Phase 3 clinical trial for a melanoma therapy failed to reach statistical significance. The lawsuit alleges the company made false and misleading statements about the trial's progress while concealing that preliminary statistical assumptions were flawed and the treatment arm was not achieving meaningful differentiation. The stock plunged following the May 15, 2026 announcement, resulting in an $11 billion market cap loss. The class period covers August 1, 2025 to May 15, 2026.

top.title: REGN Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with the Schall Law Firm
top.summary: The Schall Law Firm is seeking investors to join a class action lawsuit against Regeneron Pharmaceuticals for securities fraud. The company allegedly made false and misleading statements about its Phase III Fianlimab-Libtayo study, claiming it was likely to succeed when it actually failed to demonstrate clinical differentiation from competing therapies. Investors who purchased securities between August 1, 2025 and May 15, 2026 are encouraged to participate before the September 14, 2026 deadline.

top.title: REGN ALERT: Hagens Berman Alerts Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (REGN) Investors to Pending Securities Class Action Amid Disclosures About Key Trial’s Protocol and Ultimate Failure
top.summary: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals faces a securities class action lawsuit after failing to disclose critical information about its Phase 3 clinical trial for a melanoma treatment combination therapy. The company allegedly made false statements about trial progress while concealing that preliminary statistical assumptions were flawed and the treatment showed no meaningful differentiation over standard therapies. The trial ultimately failed to reach statistical significance, resulting in an $11 billion market cap loss. The class period covers August 1, 2025 to May 15, 2026.

The company confirmed full-year guidance of over €1.5 billion revenue and adjusted EBIT between €255-285 million, while announcing plans to acquire David Brown Defence to strengthen its portfolio in strategic markets.

The stock fell 9.27% to $39.44 per share on July 23, 2026.

top.title: ERASCA LEAD PLAINTIFF DEADLINE AUGUST 10th: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Reminds Erasca, Inc. (ERAS) Investors with Large Losses to Contact the Firm Regarding their Rights
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Erasca, Inc. alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its ERAS-0015 drug candidate. The lawsuit claims the preclinical data was based on improper comparisons and lacked reasonable basis. Following a patent infringement allegation from Revolution Medicines disclosed on April 28, 2026, Erasca's stock price declined approximately 48% from $19.15 to $9.90 per share. Investors have until August 10, 2026 to apply as lead plaintiff.

top.title: ERAS 3-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Erasca, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Class Action Lawsuit– Hagens Berman
top.summary: Hagens Berman is investigating securities fraud claims against Erasca, Inc. for allegedly misleading investors about its lead oncology drug ERAS-0015's competitive advantages, safety profile, and intellectual property protections. The company faces patent infringement allegations from Revolution Medicines and reported a patient death in clinical trials, triggering a $2.8 billion market capitalization loss. Investors with substantial losses can serve as lead plaintiffs with an August 10, 2026 deadline.

top.title: Erasca, Inc. Notice of August 10, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Reed Kathrein at Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro LLP Before Application Deadline
top.summary: Hagens Berman is investigating securities fraud claims against Erasca, Inc. for allegedly misleading investors about its lead oncology drug ERAS-0015's competitive advantages, safety profile, and intellectual property protections. top.title: MONDAY DEADLINE: Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP Announces that Erasca, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Investor Class Action Lawsuit - ERAS

Following disclosure of a patent infringement letter and adverse clinical trial data on April 27, 2026, Erasca's stock price fell approximately 59% combined. top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against ARS Pharmaceuticals Inc. for allegedly providing misleading statements about expanded insurance coverage for its epinephrine nasal spray product neffy through CVS Caremark. top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Levi & Korsinsky, LLP Notifies Investors It Has Filed a Complaint to Recover Losses Suffered by Purchasers of ARS Pharmaceuticals, Inc. Securities and Sets a Lead Plaintiff Deadline of October 5, 2026
top.summary: Law firm Levi & Korsinsky has filed a class action lawsuit against ARS Pharmaceuticals for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding expanded insurance coverage for its drug neffy through CVS Caremark. The company failed to meet its July 1, 2026 deadline for coverage expansion, causing the stock to plummet 23.9% on June 25, 2026. Investors who purchased securities between March 9 and June 24, 2026 can join the lawsuit with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 5, 2026.

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+16.4% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +16.4%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (130) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（130）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up
reasons.zh: 在上沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘突破即向上释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +3.9 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +3.9 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

reasons.en: call-over-put richness fading vs the prior session — bid rotating to puts
reasons.zh: 看涨相对看跌的溢价较上期下降 — 买盘转向看跌

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Via Transportation Shareholder Alert: ClaimsFiler Reminds Investors With Losses In Excess Of $100,000 Of Lead Plaintiff Deadline In Class Action Lawsuit Against Via Transportation, Inc. - VIA
top.summary: Investors in Via Transportation (NYSE: VIA) have until August 10, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications in a securities class action lawsuit related to the company's September 2025 IPO. The complaint alleges that the registration statement and prospectus contained materially misleading statements and omitted required disclosures. At the time of the IPO, Via was allegedly adding customers faster than they generated revenue, causing a decline in ARR per customer, and faced regulatory challenges in Germany. Via's stock has declined approximately 70% from its offering price to $14.52.

Erasca faces allegations regarding misleading preclinical data comparisons; Via Transportation failed to disclose declining ARR and regulatory issues; Embecta misrepresented guidance and segment weakness; and Zillow mischaracterized its Redfin agreement and downplayed antitrust risks. Investors have until mid-August 2026 to file lead plaintiff motions.

top.title: Wix.com Ltd. Notice of September 22, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Reed Kathrein at Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro LLP Before Application Deadline
top.summary: Wix.com faces a securities class action lawsuit following a 27% stock price drop in May 2026 after Q1 results revealed a 46% spike in operating expenses. The lawsuit alleges Wix made false statements about its AI products (Base44 and Harmony), overstating their competitiveness and performance while understating development costs. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 22, 2026.

top.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Wix.com Ltd. (WIX) Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead the Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit - RGRD Law
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Wix.com Ltd. for allegedly making false statements about its AI product offerings, overstating competitiveness and performance while understating development costs. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased Wix securities between February 19, 2025 and May 12, 2026. Multiple analyst downgrades and disappointing earnings reports triggered significant stock price declines, with the stock falling over 27% following Q1 2026 results that revealed weakness in the professional developer business and competitive challenges.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Wix.com Ltd. (WIX) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Wix.com Ltd. for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements about its AI product offerings between February 2025 and May 2026. The company allegedly overstated the competitiveness and performance of its AI products while understating associated costs. Three significant stock price declines occurred following earnings announcements revealing disappointing guidance, unexpected post-acquisition costs, and weakness in the professional developer business. The deadline to file a lead plaintiff motion is September 22, 2026.

top.title: DEADLINE ALERT for ERAS, VIA, EMBC, Z: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith Reminds Investors of Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Class Actions
top.summary: Class action lawsuits have been filed against four publicly-traded companies alleging securities fraud. Erasca faces allegations regarding misleading preclinical data comparisons; Via Transportation failed to disclose declining ARR and regulatory issues; Embecta misrepresented guidance and segment weakness; and Zillow mischaracterized its Redfin agreement and downplayed antitrust risks. Investors have until mid-August 2026 to file lead plaintiff motions.

top.title: Zillow Group Securities Fraud Class Action Arising from Alleged Anticompetitive Agreement and Related Regulatory Risks – Investors May Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq., at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC
top.summary: Investors in Zillow Group have until August 10, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications in a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Zillow and its executives failed to disclose material information about an agreement with Redfin, mischaracterizing it as a partnership rather than an acquisition, and downplayed regulatory and antitrust risks. The case claims investors suffered damages when the true details became public.

top.title: Avis Budget Group, Inc. Notice of September 29, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
